hero.subheadline: Use Graph Italia to turn your data, from a CSV or JSON file, into interactive charts. The intuitive interface makes navigation easy and the platform simple to use.

features.label: How does it work?
features.title: Turn your data into charts in a few steps
features.subtitle: From your data to creating charts and integrating them in your websites, Graph Italia supports you throughout the workflow.

items.title: Different chart styles
items.description: Pick the chart that best represents your data from a wide library. All Graph Italia charts are accessible and responsive.

items.title: Optimized upload
items.description: You can upload CSV or JSON files, or import them from other websites through a URL.

items.title: Continuous updates
items.description: Graph Italia keeps a history of remote data, such as data loaded from a URL, and refreshes it every 24 hours.

items.title: Simplified customization
items.description: Graph Italia offers several parameters to customize the layout of your charts in a simple and intuitive way.

items.title: Accessible charts by design
items.description: All the components used to build the charts follow the web accessibility guidelines.

items.title: Open Source
items.description: Released under the GNU AGPLv3 license, Graph Italia was built to be adopted and integrated by other public bodies and organizations.

integration.label: Integration via API keys
integration.title: Simplified integration
integration.subtitle: Embed the charts created on Graph Italia in your website in just three steps using API keys.

steps.title: Create and configure
steps.body: Upload your data, then create and customize your charts and/or dashboards.

steps.title: Generate your API keys
steps.body: Once done, open API Key from the user menu and generate a read-only key for the project: it lets you show your data only where you decide.

steps.title: Embed the code in your website
steps.body: Use the React component library with the API key and the identifier of your chart or dashboard: the component fetches the information and renders the chart automatically. If your website does not use React, you can use the REST API or the typed client graph-italia-cli.

integration.codeNote: If your website does not use React, you can integrate the data with the REST API or the typed client graph-italia-cli.

cta.title: Ready to shape your data?
cta.subtitle: Read our user guide and start creating your charts.
